steps: Dice and fry 250g potatoes in olive oil over medium heat until golden and tender, about 8 minutes.
Fry 3 eggs in the same pan until cooked to your liking.
Add 100g spinach and 30g cheddar to the pan, stirring until the spinach wilts and the cheese melts.
Combine everything on a plate and serve warm.
Cook 90g brown rice in water according to package directions.
Fry 3 eggs in oil until cooked to your liking.
Plate the rice, top with the fried eggs, 1 tbsp sriracha, and a handful of scallions.
Microwave the 250g white rice pouch according to package directions.
Open and drain 1 can tinned tuna, then stir in 80g sweetcorn.
Combine the rice with the tuna and corn in a bowl, drizzle with the olive oil sachet, season with salt, and stir well.
Grill or pan-cook 150g chicken breast until cooked through.
Cook white rice to make 200g cooked rice, or use pre-made rice.
Steam mixed vegetables until tender (about 5 minutes), then arrange rice, chicken, and veg on a plate.
Blend 1 banana with 300ml milk and 1 scoop whey protein to make a shake to drink on the side.
Cook white or brown rice to yield 250g cooked rice, or use pre-made.
Cube 120g tofu and toss with tamari.
Assemble rice, tofu, 1.5 cups mixed vegetables, 1 tbsp pumpkin seeds, 1 tbsp hemp seeds, and drizzle tamari over the top.
Grill or pan-cook 150g chicken breast marinated in tandoori paste until cooked through.
Warm 1 cup pre-cooked chickpea and lentil mix with 1/2 cup peas and 1 cup spinach in a pan for 2 minutes.
Plate the chicken and legume mix, add 1/2 cup yogurt on the side, and finish with 1 cup grapes.
Cook white rice to make 150g cooked rice, or use pre-made.
Warm 100g cooked beans in a pan.
Plate the rice, beans, white bread (2 slices), and small ugali (100g), then serve with 1 cup hot sweet chai.
Boil water and cook 100g spaghetti or penne until al dente, then drain.
In a pan, sauté 1 minced garlic clove in 1 tbsp olive oil for 30 seconds, then add 1 cup canned tomatoes and simmer 3 minutes.
Toss the pasta with the sauce, top with 2 tbsp parmesan and fresh basil.
Boil water and cook 120g pasta until al dente, then drain.
Toss the pasta with 120g canned tuna in olive oil, 1 cup halved cherry tomatoes, minced garlic, 1 tbsp olive oil, and fresh parsley.
Boil water and cook 100g fusilli until al dente, then drain.
Toss the pasta with 120g grilled chicken, 2 tbsp basil pesto, 4 sun-dried tomatoes, 1 cup mixed vegetables, and 1 tbsp parmesan.
Boil water and cook 120g white pasta until al dente, then drain.
Dress the hot pasta with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Prick a 300g baking potato with a fork and microwave for about 8 minutes until soft.
Heat 1 can (400g) baked beans in a pan.
Split the potato open, pour the beans over the top, drizzle with 1 tsp olive oil, and serve with a side salad.
Arrange 2 cups mixed greens on a plate with 150g leftover salmon, 1/2 avocado sliced, and 20g walnuts.
Dress with 1 tbsp olive oil and fresh lemon juice.
Fry 4 eggs until cooked to your liking.
Grill or pan-cook 150g chicken breast until cooked through.
Arrange mixed greens (2 cups) on a plate with the fried eggs and grilled chicken, then drizzle with 1 tbsp olive oil.
Drain 2 cans (170g) canned tuna and mix with 2 tbsp mayo, 1 diced celery stalk, and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Lay out 4 romaine or butter lettuce leaves and fill each with the tuna mixture.
Lay out 6 large lettuce leaves and spread thin mustard on each.
Layer 150g sliced turkey breast, sliced 1/2 avocado, and cucumber slices on the leaves, then roll and serve.
Mix 150g shredded chicken with 2 tbsp coconut yogurt, 1 tsp curry powder, 2 tbsp raisins, and 1 diced celery stalk.
Divide between 4 lettuce cups and serve.
Warm 3 corn tortillas in a dry pan or over a flame.
Mash 1/2 avocado with a squeeze of lime juice.
Fill each tortilla with 50g grilled chicken, avocado, 50g shredded cabbage, and 1 tbsp salsa.
Rinse and drain 1 can black beans, then mix with 1 can sweetcorn.
Dress the mixture with 1 tsp olive oil, a squeeze of lime juice, and a pinch of chili powder.
Serve with 2 warm corn tortillas.
Toast 2 slices whole-grain bread or bagel lightly.
Spread 2 tbsp peanut butter on the toast, then top with 1 sliced banana.
Toast or assemble 2 slices whole-grain bread or a sub roll.
Layer 100g sliced turkey or ham, lettuce, tomato slices, and mustard on the bread.
Serve with pretzels or fruit on the side.
Chop 3 hard-boiled eggs and mix with 1 tbsp mayo and mustard to taste.
Assemble on 2 slices whole-grain bread with lettuce, then serve with fruit on the side.
Warm 1 whole-wheat tortilla slightly to make it pliable.
Spread 4 tbsp hummus on the tortilla, then layer 1/2 cup shredded carrot, cucumber slices, spinach, and 1/4 avocado.
Roll tightly and serve.
Warm 1 large whole-wheat tortilla slightly to make it pliable.
Massage 1 cup kale with a small drizzle of olive oil and lemon juice.
Shred 120g rotisserie chicken and toss with the kale and 2 tbsp dried cranberries, then wrap in the tortilla.
Slice 1 tomato and arrange on 2 slices whole-grain bread or ciabatta with 60g fresh mozzarella.
Top with fresh basil leaves, drizzle with 1 tsp olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
Arrange 1 cup cottage cheese on a plate with 10 whole-grain crackers, 1 cup apple or grapes, and 15 almonds.
Cut 1 whole-wheat pita in half and fill each pocket with 1.5 tbsp hummus, 10g mixed nuts, apple slices, and dried apricots.
Open 1 tin canned wild salmon and drain if needed, then arrange on a plate with 10 whole-grain crackers, 1 apple cut into slices, and the olive oil sachet for drizzling.
Cook 250g white rice using a travel rice cooker or pre-made rice.
Plate the rice with 2 tbsp almond butter, 2 slices bread, and 1 banana on the side.
Cook white rice to make 250g cooked rice, or use pre-made.
Toast 2 slices white bread lightly.
Spread 2 tbsp jam on the toast, arrange sliced banana alongside the rice, and season rice with a pinch of salt.
Spread 2 tbsp almond butter on 1 medium banana (sliced or whole for dipping).
Slice 1 apple and serve with 1.5 tbsp peanut butter for dipping.
Toast 2 slices white or sourdough bread.
Spread 2 tbsp honey on the warm toast.
Toast 2 slices bread lightly.
Spread 1.5 tbsp peanut butter on the toast and top with sliced banana.
Brew 1 cup coffee and serve alongside.
Spread 2 tbsp chocolate hazelnut spread on 2 slices white bread.
Toast or warm 1/2 white bagel lightly.
Spread 1 tbsp honey on the bagel and serve with 1 banana.
Spread 2 tbsp strawberry jam on 3 plain rice cakes.
Spread 3 tbsp strawberry jam on 2 slices white bread.
Pour 60g mini pretzels into a bowl.
Pour 300ml 100% apple or orange juice into a glass.
Pour 40g plain salted rice crackers into a bowl.
Open 2 x 113g unsweetened applesauce pouches.
Portion 50g dried mango into a bowl.
Arrange 4 Medjool dates on a plate.
Steam or heat 250ml soy milk to about 65°C, then pour into a cup.
Add 1 shot espresso to the warm soy milk and stir.
Serve with 1 banana on the side.
Arrange 40g mini pretzels and 40g hummus in a bowl or on a plate for dipping.
Pour 60g whole-grain or oat cereal into a bowl, add 200ml milk, and top with 1/2 sliced banana.
Pour 120g cornflakes into a bowl, add 250ml milk, and drizzle with 1 tbsp honey.
Spread 2 tbsp peanut butter on 1 slice white bread, then spread 1 tbsp jam on the other slice.
Press the slices together, cut into quarters, and serve.
Spread 1 tsp butter on 1 small baguette or white roll, then layer 40g sliced ham and 20g cheese inside.
Cut into quarters and serve.
Spread 1.5 tbsp peanut butter on 2 plain rice cakes, then top with 1/2 sliced banana.
Pit and blend 35g dates with 17g hazelnuts, 1 tsp cocoa powder, a splash of orange juice, and a pinch of salt into a paste.
Press the mixture firmly into a small parchment-lined pan and cut into 12 squares to portion.
Cut 150g carrot and cucumber into sticks, then serve with 60g hummus for dipping.
Cut 1 whole-wheat pita into triangles for dipping and serve with 60g hummus.
Slice 1 apple and serve on the plate as well.
Warm 100g canned black beans in a small pan if desired.
Arrange 60g corn tortilla chips on a plate, top with the black beans, 3 tbsp salsa, 1/2 mashed avocado, and 30g dairy-free cheese.
Boil water and add 150g frozen edamame in pod, cooking for 3 minutes.
Drain and sprinkle generously with sea salt, then serve with a lime wedge.
Heat 300ml water in a small pot until steaming.
Whisk in 40g millet flour slowly to avoid lumps, then stir constantly for 3 minutes until thick and smooth.
Stir in 1 tbsp sugar and serve warm.
Pour 250ml mursik or plain kefir into a glass and serve.
Dissolve 30g panela in 500ml warm water, stirring until dissolved.
Add 1 tbsp lime juice and a pinch of salt, then stir and serve warm or chilled.
Toast or warm 1 whole-grain flatbread lightly.
Layer 40g prosciutto, 2 fresh figs (halved), a handful of rocket, on the flatbread, then drizzle lightly with balsamic.
Dice 100g cucumber and 100g cherry tomatoes, then toss with 30g feta, 1 tsp olive oil, and oregano to taste.
Toast 2 slices whole-grain bread lightly.
Boil or poach 2 eggs until cooked to your liking.
Top the toast with 1/2 sliced avocado and the cooked eggs, then sprinkle with chilli flakes.
Boil water in a pot, carefully add 2 eggs, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cool in ice water, then peel and serve with a sprinkle of salt.
Arrange 2 hard-boiled eggs, 30g aged cheddar or Swiss cheese, and 80g grapes on a plate.
Serve 1 string cheese stick with 1 whole apple.
Lay 100g sliced turkey breast flat, spread a small amount of mustard on each slice, add a slice of cheese (40g total), roll tightly, and serve.
Cut 1/2 cucumber lengthwise into thin ribbons using a mandoline or vegetable peeler.
Spread a thin layer of cream cheese (2 tbsp) on each ribbon, layer with 80g smoked salmon, add a few capers, and roll tightly.
Cut 1/2 avocado into a bowl, sprinkle with a pinch of sea salt, and squeeze fresh lime juice over the top.
Arrange 30g macadamia nuts, 80g mixed berries, and 2 tbsp double cream on a plate or in a bowl.
Heat 500ml bone broth in a small pot until steaming.
Stir in 100g shredded rotisserie chicken and a pinch of salt, then serve warm.
Arrange 40g beef jerky, 40g dried mango, and 2 plain rice cakes on a plate.
Arrange 8 plain rice crackers on a plate, layer with 80g sliced turkey breast and 1/2 cup cucumber slices, then drizzle with yellow mustard.
Open 1 flavoured tuna pouch and arrange on a plate with 8 crackers and 2 pickle spears.
Mix 40g each almonds, cashews, and peanuts with 20g sunflower and pumpkin seeds in a bowl to portion.
Mix 30g pumpkin seeds, 20g sunflower seeds, 30g dried cranberries, and 30g dried apricots in a bowl to portion.
Pop or air-pop 30g popcorn kernels in an air popper or on the stovetop.
Lightly spray with olive oil and salt to taste.
Cut 2 kiwi fruits in half and scoop out the flesh with a spoon, or peel and slice whole.
Wash 150g seedless grapes, freeze in a single layer, then portion as needed.
Pour 500ml low-fat chocolate milk into a glass.
Combine 200g Greek yogurt in a bowl with 1 banana sliced, 1 tbsp peanut butter, and a light drizzle of honey.
Combine 200g cottage cheese with 150g pineapple chunks in a bowl.
Combine 200g cottage cheese in a bowl with 1 tbsp peanut butter and 1 tsp honey, stirring well to mix.
Dice 1/2 cucumber and 100g cherry tomatoes, then toss with 200g cottage cheese, 1 tsp olive oil, black pepper, and 1 tbsp pumpkin seeds.
Mix 30g casein protein powder with 300ml milk or water and stir until dissolved, then serve.
Blend 1 scoop whey or collagen protein with 60ml double cream, ice, water, and 1 tsp cocoa powder until smooth.
Blend 1 banana, 300ml milk, 1 scoop whey protein, 80g frozen berries, and a handful of spinach until smooth.
Blend 300ml almond milk, 1 tbsp almond butter, 1 banana, 2 dates, and 1 scoop plant protein until smooth.
Blend 1 cup frozen wild blueberries, 1/2 banana, 1 cup coconut milk, and 1 scoop vanilla whey protein until smooth.
Blend 1 firm banana, 100g strawberries, 200ml lactose-free milk, and ice until smooth.
Blend 150g cannellini beans with 1 tbsp olive oil, a squeeze of lemon juice, minced garlic, and salt until smooth and creamy.
Serve the dip with 150g carrot, cucumber, and pepper sticks for dipping.
Arrange 100g grapes, 30g cheddar, and 4 whole-grain crackers on a plate.
